<div class="description">
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<hr>
<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">MapPolygon</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-nativebase" title="class in com.here">NativeBase</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>A visual representation of a polygon on the map. Can be used to visualize areas of all shapes
 and sizes.
 <p>The geometry to be visualized is represented by an instance of <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geopolygon" title="class in com.here.sdk.core"><code>GeoPolygon</code></a>.
 To display circular areas (for example, a position accuracy indicator) use a GeoPolygon
 created from a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geocircle" title="class in com.here.sdk.core"><code>GeoCircle</code></a> using <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geopolygon#%3Cinit%3E(com.here.sdk.core.GeoCircle)"><code>GeoPolygon(GeoCircle)</code></a>.
 <p>Note:
 <ul>
 <li>The polygon shape should not cover more than half of the globe,
 otherwise unexpected results may occur.</li>
 <li>Polygons which are self-intersecting are not supported and may lead to render
 artifacts.</li>
 <li>The inner boundaries (holes) specified in the GeoPolygon are ignored.</li>
 </ul></div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h3>Constructor Detail</h3>
<a id="&lt;init&gt;(com.here.sdk.core.GeoPolygon,com.here.sdk.core.Color)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>MapPolygon</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;MapPolygon&#8203;(@NonNull
                  <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geopolygon" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">GeoPolygon</a>&nbsp;geometry,
                  @NonNull
                  <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;color)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a new MapPolygon instance with outline visualization disabled and containing the geometry passed in.
 <p>The winding order of the vertices can be in clockwise or counter-clockwise order.
 It is recomended to provide the outer boundary ordered clockwise and closed.
 <p>Note:
 <ul>
 <li>The polygon shape should not cover more than half of the globe,
 otherwise unexpected results may occur.</li>
 <li>Polygons which are self-intersecting are not supported and may lead to render
 artifacts.</li>
 <li>The inner boundaries (holes) specified in the GeoPolygon are ignored.</li>
 </ul></div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>geometry</code> - <p>The list of vertices representing the outer boundary of polygon.</dd>
<dd><code>color</code> - <p>The fill color for the polygon</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="&lt;init&gt;(com.here.sdk.core.GeoPolygon,com.here.sdk.core.Color,com.here.sdk.core.Color,double)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>MapPolygon</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;MapPolygon&#8203;(@NonNull
                  <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-geopolygon" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">GeoPolygon</a>&nbsp;geometry,
                  @NonNull
                  <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;color,
                  @NonNull
                  <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;outlineColor,
                  double&nbsp;outlineWidthInPixels)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a new MapPolygon instance with outline visualization enabled and containing the geometry passed in.
 <p>Transparent outlines are not supported. Any color with transparency (alpha value other than 1)
 will be rendered as fully opaque by interpreting the alpha value as 1.
 <p>The winding order of the vertices can be in clockwise or counter-clockwise order.
 It is recomended to provide the outer boundary ordered clockwise and closed.
 <p>Note:
 <ul>
 <li>The polygon shape should not cover more than half of the globe,
 otherwise unexpected results may occur.</li>
 <li>Polygons which are self-intersecting are not supported and may lead to render
 artifacts.</li>
 <li>The inner boundaries (holes) specified in the GeoPolygon are ignored.</li>
 </ul></div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>geometry</code> - <p>The list of vertices representing the outer boundary of polygon.</dd>
<dd><code>color</code> - <p>The fill color for the polygon.</dd>
<dd><code>outlineColor</code> - <p>The color of the polygon outline, alpha channel is ignored and treated as 1.</dd>
<dd><code>outlineWidthInPixels</code> - <p>The width of the polygon outline (in pixels). Negative values are clamped to 0.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</section>

<div class="block"><p>Gets the draw order of this map polygon relative to other map polygons. Default value is 0.</div>

<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The draw order of this map polygon relative to other map polygons.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="setDrawOrder(int)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setDrawOrder</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;setDrawOrder&#8203;(int&nbsp;value)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Sets the draw order of this map polygon relative to other map polygons.
 <p>Polygon with higher draw order value are drawn
 on top of polygons with lower draw order.
 <p>In case multiple polygons have the same draw order value
 then the order in which they were added to the scene matters. Last added polygon is drawn on top.
 <p>Allowed range is 0-1023. Values outside this range will be clamped.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>value</code> - <p>The draw order of this map polygon relative to other map polygons.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="getVisibilityRanges()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getVisibilityRanges</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasurerange" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureRange</a>&gt;&nbsp;getVisibilityRanges()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the list of visibility ranges. The map polygon is visible only inside these map measure
 ranges. When empty (the default), the map polygon is visible without map measure restrictions.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The list of visibility ranges. The map polygon is visible only inside these map measure ranges.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="setVisibilityRanges(java.util.List)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setVisibilityRanges</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;setVisibilityRanges&#8203;(@NonNull
                                java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasurerange" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureRange</a>&gt;&nbsp;value)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Sets visibility ranges for this map polygon. A range is half open -
 [minimumZoomLevel, maximumZoomLevel), the given maximum value is not contained in the range.
 The map polygon is visible only inside these map measure ranges.
 <p>When empty (the default), the map polygon is visible without map measure restrictions.
 Only <code>MapMeasureRange</code>(s) of <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind#ZOOM_LEVEL"><code>MapMeasure.Kind.ZOOM_LEVEL</code></a> type are supported.
 <code>MapMeasureRange</code>(s) of other unsupported types will be ignored.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>value</code> - <p>The list of visibility ranges. The map polygon is visible only inside these map measure ranges.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="getOutlineColor()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getOutlineColor</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;getOutlineColor()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the color of the polygon outline. The default outline color is opaque white.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The color of the polygon outline.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="setOutlineColor(com.here.sdk.core.Color)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setOutlineColor</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;setOutlineColor&#8203;(@NonNull
                            <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;value)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Sets the color of the polygon outline.
 <p>Transparent outlines are not supported. Any color with transparency (alpha value other than 1)
 will be rendered as fully opaque.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>value</code> - <p>The color of the polygon outline.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="getOutlineWidth()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getOutlineWidth</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;double&nbsp;getOutlineWidth()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the outline width of the polygon in pixels.
 <p>By default, the outline width is set to zero.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The width of the polygon outline in pixels.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="setOutlineWidth(double)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setOutlineWidth</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;setOutlineWidth&#8203;(double&nbsp;value)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Sets the outline width of the polygon in pixels.
 <p>The value should be greater than or equal to 0.
 Negative values are clamped to zero.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>value</code> - <p>The width of the polygon outline in pixels.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</section>
</li>
</ul>
